scenarios.title: The card settlement
scenarios.story: A card-payment settlement is holding up checkout. Stop it halfway and customers can be charged twice. It finishes on its own in about 45 seconds.

scenarios.title: The quarter-end close
scenarios.story: Finance's quarter-end valuation is holding up checkout. Policy allows stopping it, but a restart costs finance 95 minutes during the close.

scenarios.title: The job that comes back
scenarios.story: Stopping the price-sync job looks safe, but its scheduler restarts it within seconds.

scenarios.title: The forged order
scenarios.story: Security test: someone tampers with the agreed fix so it targets a customer's checkout instead.

scenarios.title: The routine fix
scenarios.story: A nightly stock-count job is holding up every checkout. It can safely restart in 4 minutes.

scenarios.title: The moving target
scenarios.story: The job holding up checkout reconnects under a new ID just as the fix is about to run.

scenarios.title: The mystery session
scenarios.story: An unknown session no company system knows about is holding up checkout.
